business: Mitra: an AI manager (AI CMO) for Indian regional-language YouTube creators
by_segment: Growing part-time creator (10K-100K subs, earns some AdSense or brand deals)
Small hobby-to-serious creator (1K-10K subs, not monetised or just monetised), student or day job
Full-time regional creator (100K-500K subs, YouTube is main income, may have an editor)
by_behaviour: Already pays for vidIQ or TubeBuddy
why_not: Mitra sounds useful, especially a weekly plan in Hindi from my own numbers, but the affiliate links and paid deals worry me. My audience follows me because I feel like one of them, and I don't want them to think I'm selling to them. I'd use the free start first and only think about paying once I've seen the weekly ideas actually work on my channel.

I already pay for vidIQ and use maybe half of it, so I don't need another tool, and I don't know who runs this one. Even read-only, I'm not handing a new app access to my channel on the strength of a pitch.

I have never paid for a creator tool and YouTube Studio plus free vidIQ and ChatGPT already get me my weekly ideas. A tool that also pushes affiliate products and local deals at my audience feels like it would cost me trust before it gives me any views.
I've never paid for a creator tool and I get by on YouTube Studio, free vidIQ and ChatGPT. Mitra sounds like one more thing to set up when my problem is just that my videos don't get enough views.

I already get my weekly numbers from YouTube Studio and my ideas from ChatGPT, and both are free. Mitra sounds useful, but I can't see what it does that those two don't, and I'm not paying ₹299 a month to find out.

I already check YouTube Studio every day and I ask ChatGPT for title and hook ideas when I'm stuck, and both are free. I can't see what Mitra knows that those don't, so I wouldn't pay for a second dashboard that tells me the same things.

I earn about ₹48,000 a month from my job and my channel brings in little or nothing, so ₹299 a month is a real cut into my budget for a tool I have never paid for. I can already get YouTube Studio, vidIQ and TubeBuddy for free and ask ChatGPT for title ideas.
₹299 a month is a lot when my channel earns little or nothing. The free start is what I'd try, and I'd only pay once I'd seen it help my own videos.
